added.member: UI: CSS cursor url() images shown on both hosts
added.summary: cursor: url(<icon or texture>) [<x> <y>], …, <keyword> now shows the first image that loads at its hotspot (an atlas icon by name or a texture by its asset handle, at most 128x128), the keyword where none does; images over auto stop the parent's keyword. og.ui's frame answer carries cursorImage when it changes and the web shell sets the canvas's CSS cursor from it. UiFrame gains cursor_images.

A window that sends {"CursorSubscribe":{"version":1}} after Hello hears {"Cursor":{"version":1,"keyword","image"}} once and whenever the UI's cursor changes; FrameLink::set_cursor hands it over. Nothing changes for a window that does not subscribe.
